measures.name: task_processing_time
measures.definition: Active handling time for one item at one named stage.

measures.name: stage_service_capacity
measures.definition: Maximum items a stage can complete during one business day under the observed staffing pattern.

measures.name: completed_output
measures.definition: Items that pass the release stage during the observation window.

measures.name: first_pass_yield
measures.definition: Share of items accepted at a stage without return to an earlier stage.

measures.name: queue_age_p95
measures.definition: Ninety-fifth percentile elapsed wait before service begins at a stage.

measures.name: rework_load
measures.definition: Stage capacity consumed by items returned from a downstream check.

provenance: Project-owned synthetic measurement dictionary; it contains no benchmark verdict or real operational data.
